method: Twenty alternating unprofiled pairs per scenario, exact frozen baseline build_projection function compiled in memory versus candidate, identical helpers/inputs/fixed UTC. Enabled store root exists and prepare=True. Direct prior payloads fully validated before trials. Service trials prime only previously verified encoded cache entries at original age20s, so every request takes real generation revalidation; a fresh one-worker service is closed before switching variant. Process CPU is reported separately; concurrent full-suite host load makes wall values diagnostic only. No production/native/guest acceptance.
